components.name: PhoneInput
components.doc: A phone number field with a country picker. The country button grows into a searchable list, the number formats as it is typed with a faint guide showing the rest of the expected shape, pasted or autofilled international numbers pick their own country, and the value comes out in E.164. Typing "+" in the number jumps into the picker with a calling code search.

members.name: dial
members.doc: Country calling code without the plus, such as "44".

members.name: patterns
members.doc: National formats from shortest to longest. `#` is a digit, anything else is a separator.

members.name: trunk
members.doc: A national number people may type before the number itself, such as "0" in "07911 123456".

members.name: example
members.doc: A realistic national number, used for the placeholder and the typing guide.

members.name: areaCodes
members.doc: Area codes that pick this country when several share a calling code, such as Canada inside +1.

members.name: formatted
members.doc: The number as shown in the field, without the calling code.

members.name: value
members.doc: The number in E.164, such as "+14155550132". An empty string clears the field.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Fires on every edit with the E.164 number (empty when there are no digits) and its parsed details.

members.name: country
members.doc: ISO code of the selected country.

members.name: defaultCountry
members.doc: ISO code used until someone picks a country or enters an international number.

members.name: countries
members.doc: Limit the picker to these ISO codes.

members.name: preferredCountries
members.doc: Pinned at the top of the picker under "Suggested".

members.name: validate
members.doc: Show a message after blur when the number is incomplete. On by default.

members.name: name
members.doc: Adds a hidden input carrying the E.164 value for native form submission.
